rollback_action: Use sealed v0.08 release behavior as the promoted parent while preserving v0.09, v0.09.1, and v0.09.2 evidence and opening a governed corrective candidate.
trigger_conditions: Any mandatory v0.09.2 gate later proves falsely recorded, bypassed, or unreproducible.
Any v0.09.2 frozen artifact hash mismatch is discovered.
Any critical active regression fails in the sealed deliverable.
Independent metric reconciliation finds missing/unavailable evidence that was recorded as zero or PASS.
Final shipping manifest or freshly extracted ZIP verification fails.
preservation_requirements: Preserve all v0.09.2 frozen artifacts, raw evaluation evidence, defects, regressions, scorecard, and decision even if runtime use rolls back to v0.08.
Preserve v0.09 and v0.09.1 RETRY REQUIRED history byte-for-byte; rollback must not rewrite failed history into a pass.
Do not rewrite append-only events or ledgers to make rollback appear as non-occurrence.
